<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="RhV1Ljt5VV1ByqQdVfeP"> <mxGraphModel dx="2038" dy="1081" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": " flowchart LR
 Root[/api/v2/ta/] --> Users[Users]
 Root --> Slots[Slots]
 Root --> Bookings[Bookings]
 Root --> Tickets[Tickets]
 Root --> Feedback[Feedback]
 Root --> Ping[/_ping/]

 Users --> U1[GET /users/me<br/>any auth]
 Users --> U2[POST /users/promote<br/>admin+moderator + 10/min]
 Users --> U3[POST /users/demote<br/>admin+moderator + 10/min]
 Users --> U4[GET /users/tas<br/>admin+moderator]
 Users --> U5[GET /users/tas-public<br/>any auth]

 Slots --> S1[GET /slots<br/>any auth]
 Slots --> S2[POST /slots<br/>TA only + 30/min]
 Slots --> S3[GET /slots/mine<br/>TA only]
 Slots --> S4[PATCH /slots/:id<br/>TA only]
 Slots --> S5[DELETE /slots/:id<br/>TA only]
 Slots --> S6[GET /slots/:id/bookings<br/>TA only]

 Bookings --> B1[POST /bookings<br/>any auth + 20/min]
 Bookings --> B2[GET /bookings/mine<br/>any auth]
 Bookings --> B3[POST /bookings/:id/cancel<br/>any auth]
 Bookings --> B4[POST /bookings/:id/meet-link<br/>TA only]
 Bookings --> B5[POST /bookings/:id/complete<br/>TA only]
 Bookings --> B6[POST /bookings/:id/feedback<br/>any auth]

 Tickets --> T1[POST /tickets<br/>any auth + 20/min]
 Tickets --> T2[GET /tickets/mine<br/>any auth]
 Tickets --> T3[GET /tickets/assigned<br/>TA only]
 Tickets --> T4[GET /tickets<br/>admin+moderator]
 Tickets --> T5[GET /tickets/open-queue<br/>TA+admin override]
 Tickets --> T6[GET /tickets/:id<br/>any auth]
 Tickets --> T7[PATCH /tickets/:id<br/>TA+admin override]
 Tickets --> T8[DELETE /tickets/:id<br/>any auth]
 Tickets --> T9[POST /tickets/:id/messages<br/>any auth]
 Tickets --> T10[GET /tickets/:id/messages<br/>any auth]

 Feedback --> F1[GET /feedback/ta/:email<br/>any auth]
 Feedback --> F2[GET /feedback/mine<br/>any auth]

 style U2 fill:#fca5a5
 style U3 fill:#fca5a5
 style U4 fill:#fca5a5
 style T4 fill:#fca5a5
 style S2 fill:#fed7aa
 style T1 fill:#fed7aa
